KEANO Vintage 7-Speed Girls' Bicycle with Basket & Dual V-Brakes
Let your child ride in style with the KEANO Vintage 7-Speed Girls' Bicycle. Combining classic retro aesthetics with modern performance, this step-through bicycle features a smooth 7-speed Shimano gear system, a woven front basket, and dual V-brakes—perfect for young riders navigating neighborhood paths and park trails with confidence.

Classic elegance meets modern engineering: KEANO 7-Speed Vintage Girls' Bike.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Double protection for double peace of mind—engineered with precision braking, smooth Shimano shifting, and a safe chain guard to grow alongside your child."
Advanced Safety & Comfort Features
The KEANO bicycle is equipped with a Dual V-Brake System providing hand-lever operated stopping power specifically proportioned for smaller hands. An enclosed P-chain guard eliminates riding hazards, while the durable high-carbon steel frame ensures long-lasting stability on every adventure.

Dual V-brakes, ergonomic hand grips, and an enclosed P-chain guard for maximum riding safety.

Smooth 7-speed gearing system allows effortless shifting across varying terrains.

Child-Friendly Ergonomics

Smooth 7-Speed Shifting: Genuine Shimano derailleur provides seamless adaptability for flat pavement and gentle slopes.

Dual V-Brakes: Precise front and rear handbrakes with short-reach levers designed for small hands.

Full Protection: Enclosed P-style chain guard protects clothing and prevents accidental contact with moving parts.

Growth-Ready Comfort: Tool-free quick-release seat post and spring-cushioned saddle adjust easily as your child grows.

Size Chart & Fit Guide
Choose the perfect size based on your child's age and height range to ensure an ergonomic and comfortable fit.

Quick & Easy Assembly
The KEANO girls' bike arrives 85% pre-assembled. With all essential assembly tools included, you can have it completely built and ready to ride in under 30 minutes.

Watch: Step-by-step assembly guide to get your KEANO bicycle ready for the road.

See It In Action

Watch the KEANO 7-Speed Girls' Bike in action: Smooth performance and classic charm.

Brake System
Front & Rear Linear Pull Dual V-Brakes

Saddle & Grips
Padded Spring Comfort Seat with Cushioned Ergonomic Grips

Available Colors
Vintage Blue, Royal Purple, Blossom Pink, Mint Green, Sunshine Yellow

Included Accessories
Woven Front Basket, Rear Utility Cargo Rack, Kickstand, Wheel Reflectors, Fenders, Bell

Our Guarantee
Your satisfaction and safety are our highest priorities. Every KEANO bike is backed by our Lifetime Frame Warranty and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
